description: Vendor-neutral capability-routing scenarios. Expected/forbidden reflect intent; CI validates structure only, not model behavior.

cases.prompt: Take this proposed software feature from initial requirements and backlog through technical design, TDD implementation, automated tests, code review, and opening the required pull requests. Preserve approvals before every external action.
Assess the readiness and missing evidence for taking this proposed change from requirements through pull requests. Do not modify source, create commits, or publish anything.
Take this stakeholder change request through elicitation, validated requirements, and a prioritized backlog, then stop. Do not design or implement it.
Produce just the bounded technical design and interface decisions for this already approved slice. Stop before implementation and pull requests.
Review the final bounded diff in advisory mode before we consider publishing a PR. Report verified findings and one review verdict, without editing files.

Create the remote pull request from the already published and fully verified feature branch, using the current pre-publication review evidence. Do not start the requirements-to-implementation pipeline again.
Invoke /review/review-code for the final PR diff in advisory mode before publication. Examine the complete head/base, report one evidence-backed verdict, and do not create the PR.
Coordinate this change from requirements and backlog through design, implementation, tests, review and pull requests. Preserve evidence and stop before operations lacking authorization.

Invoke /delivery/deliver-change for a software increment, from Requirements and backlog through implementation and review to PR creation. The requested target is pr-created; do not assume permission to push or publish.
Invoke /delivery/deliver-change to coordinate only the Design stage of an already planned change. Stop at designed without implementation or PR mutations.
Invoke /requirements/specify-and-plan-change solely for elicitation, requirements validation and backlog generation; do not orchestrate design, implementation or PR creation.
Explain what an end-to-end software delivery pipeline would involve; do not invoke a slash command, edit files, or publish anything.
We have an unclear request for a subscription renewal feature. Interview for stakeholder needs, current behavior, and missing business decisions before writing requirements.
Stakeholder intent and acceptance evidence are already established. Write precise, traceable functional and temporal requirements for the approved renewal behavior.
Here is an existing requirements specification with acceptance scenarios. Assess ambiguity, contradictions, traceability, and readiness for technical design without editing it.
We still do not know what problem the users face. Identify stakeholders, investigate goals, and surface unanswered questions; do not assess an existing specification.
The specification is already frozen. Only inspect its quality and contradictions before backlog planning; do not draft or change requirements.
Before automating tests, explore concrete examples, counterexamples, edge cases, and stable scenario identities for this subscription rule.
Turn accepted requirements and supported defects into a traceable set of small backlog slices with dependencies and readiness decisions.
Refine the existing backlog items and dependencies without inventing new product behavior or silently altering acceptance criteria.
The change boundary is accepted. Compare interface and data ownership options and prepare a bounded, reversible technical design; do not edit application code.
In a disposable test repository, implement the approved refund endpoint slice and run local checks; code and tests for this exact slice are authorized.
In a disposable fixture repository, add focused automated tests for the already specified refund rules; do not change production code.
I need additional regression tests only, with no production changes; all behavior and expected results are already documented.
For this explicitly authorized feature slice in a disposable repo, use test-driven development with observed RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR cycles.
Read the current tests for confidence gaps, but do not edit files or start test-first implementation just because tests are involved.
Review the explicit pull-request diff for correctness and security, in read-only advisory mode, with evidence for each finding.
The task is to implement the explicitly approved small change in a disposable repo and run existing checks; an independent code review was not requested.
The code review concerns payment authorization and a schema migration. Coordinate distinct security and reliability investigators with verifiable isolated handoffs if supported.
Review a tiny documentation typo with no executable change, read-only. Do not spin up multiple specialists for an R0 change.
Two reviewers disagree whether a duplicate charge is reachable. Independently falsify or confirm this candidate finding using actual code and tests.
After the delivery, compare observed operational outcomes with the expected behavior; record evidence, uncertainties, and learning without applying fixes.
Coordinate this approved change through selected Requirements, Design, Implementation, Review and Git handoffs toward the requested stage, preserving evidence.
In a disposable Git fixture with explicit local commit permission, partition completed work into verified atomic semantic commits.
Diagnose how to synchronize the existing feature branch with its verified upstream while preserving uncommitted changes; use read-only inspection.
Propose a safe plan for two stacked pull requests with coherent boundaries and traceability; do not publish or push anything.
Determine a semantic version increment from documented public API compatibility changes and this repository release policy; do not create tags.
Analyze a rebase conflict from base, ours, and theirs; explain intended integrated behavior without staging or continuing the operation.
Delegate discovery of unclear stakeholder needs and supporting sources before anyone writes formal acceptance requirements.
Delegate drafting formal acceptance criteria and temporal constraints from an already approved set of needs; exclude backlog creation.
Delegate splitting defined behavior into a traceable backlog with dependencies, not a redesign of the approved requirements.
Delegate a read-only architecture decision for a bounded change from accepted constraints, without implementation.
In an isolated disposable repo with explicitly granted edits, delegate implementing the selected code slice and reporting actual checks.
Delegate adding automated tests in a disposable fixture for a specified behavior only; production code edits are not authorized.
Explicitly delegate an independent read-only review of the bounded payment code diff; one Review Lead should own the final verdict.
As Code Review Lead, delegate the authentication and data-authorization concerns in this payment diff to a read-only security specialist.
As Code Review Lead, delegate idempotency, retries, and crash-window risks in the renewal diff to the reliability specialist.
The review team has contradictory findings for the same reachable state transition. Delegate independent falsification without issuing the final verdict.
Review a one-word documentation correction; there are no separate risk lenses justifying specialist subagents.
Delegate read-only Git analysis to determine PR boundaries and branch freshness while keeping push and remote creation unauthorized.
Delegate planning the cross-context handoffs toward the requested stage without claiming the coordinator performed each specialist's work.
Invoke /validate-requirements for the supplied specification and report its quality findings read-only.
Invoke /specify-requirements using this accepted elicitation handoff to draft the defined requirements.
Invoke /review-code on this explicit patch in read-only advisory profile with evidence; do not publish a PR.
Invoke /plan-pull-requests to plan separate coherent changes; read-only analysis only.
Invoke /determine-semantic-version to analyze an API change; do not create a release or tag.
Implement this small approved code change in a disposable repository; no slash command was entered and there is no separate review request.
Provide a suggested semantic commit message for this diff, without executing a Git commit or any slash command.
Draft the text for a pull request but do not create it remotely; no slash command or external mutation is authorized.
Explain which existing tests cover this code; I did not request test edits or invoke /generate-tests.
We are formally specifying domain business rules and acceptance conditions from authoritative stakeholder evidence.
We are refining traceable backlog slices and dependencies from accepted requirements, without changing the source semantics.
Choose proportional requirements rigor for a low-risk documentation change without imposing a full high-assurance specification.
We are making technical design tradeoffs for an architecture slice before authorizing any production edits.
In a disposable test repository, implement an authorized production slice and verify behavior; do not claim independent review.
The only authorized task is to design deterministic automated tests that cover a known boundary case.
Perform a read-only independent Code Review of the explicit diff, assess impact and calibrate evidence-backed findings.
During the review of financial payment code, investigate external side-effect windows and idempotency failure patterns.
Review a harmless README formatting change with no reachable runtime side effects or high-risk mechanism.
This repository explicitly uses Gitflow with develop, release and hotfix branches. Evaluate the branch lifecycle under that policy.
This repository explicitly uses trunk-based development and has no develop/release Gitflow branch model. Plan its branch strategy.
The project declares SemVer and a public API; determine if a backward incompatible API change affects MAJOR.
This private ad-hoc script has no declared public API or SemVer release policy. Do not infer a major version bump.
Create a scoped local commit for a verified intention following repository message conventions and atomicity.
Plan a small reviewable pull-request boundary and assess scope, template, quality gates and readiness without publication.
An intermittent renewal worker duplicates a payment under concurrent retries. Diagnose the technical mechanism from existing traces and code read-only; do not edit the system.
Two stakeholders disagree on the intended billing grace-period policy and no runtime defect has been observed. Clarify authority and expected behavior before specification.
During a requested PR review, falsify an already reported candidate finding against the frozen diff and relevant tests; issue no standalone incident diagnosis.
The expected behavior is already established, and I explicitly authorize only automated regression test additions in a throwaway repository. Do not investigate a new defect.
Implementation is authorized for a bounded bug-fix slice. An unexpected failing check has an uncertain cause: investigate first, then apply only the authorized correction and rerun verification.
Investigate a crash reported from production by reading pinned logs and Git history. Do not patch source, create tests, deploy or change infrastructure; report uncertainty.
Delegate a bounded, read-only investigation of an intermittent queue-processing fault to a specialist who returns causal evidence without remediation.
An approved code fix and acceptance scenarios are ready. Delegate the in-scope source and test modification to the owner of implementation, not a read-only investigator.
Run /debugging/investigate-defect for the observed deadlock and return source-backed hypotheses only; do not edit files or create a PR.
Run /review/review-code on this specific PR diff in advisory mode; independently verify candidate findings and report the single Review verdict.
During an explicitly requested read-only technical defect investigation, apply the invariant that causal evidence is required and potentially side-effecting probes need separate approval.
Discover stakeholder goals and business definitions for a new renewal feature with no observed technical failure or source repository. Do not import debugging constraints.
